text: Greyson's Neighborhood Illustrate the story here: Greyson lives in a beige house on the corner of Eighth Street and Great Lake Road. He has lived there for eighteen years. Greyson loves his neighborhood because he has great neighbors. Any time he passes someone on his street they always wave and say hey. Greyson's next-door neighbor is Stewart. Stewart loves to cook and has a huge grill in his backyard. Every Friday, Stewart hosts a dinner party for Greyson and some other neighbors. Last Friday, Stewart grilled steak and corn. It was quite tasty! Greyson's neighbors across the street are Cosmo and Wanda. They have three dogs, four cats, and one fish. That's eight pets! Sometimes, Greyson walks the dogs for Cosmo and Wanda if they need a break. When Greyson walks the dogs, they always go straight to the park to play fetch. Greyson loves his beige house, his nice neighborhood, and his friendly neighbors. He thinks he just might stay there for another eighteen years.
